title: Watch, Infer, Coordinate: Inferring Robot Partner Constraints for Zero-Shot Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2610.02170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robots operating in the physical world will increasingly need to coordinate with other robots, particularly in manipulation tasks where an object may be too large or heavy for a single robot to carry alone. Physical limitations caused by hardware degradation or actuator faults can restrict the actions a robot can reliably execute, yet these limitations may be unknown to its partner. We study whether a helper can infer a robot partner's physical constraints from observing it coordinate with another robot, then use the inferred capability to coordinate with the same partner on a new task. This is difficult because a demonstration shows what the constrained robot did, but not what it could have done. In physically coupled tasks, the other robot may also compensate for its limitations, making those limitations difficult to identify from the constrained robot's behavior alone. translated_title: 观察、推断、协调：推断机器人伙伴约束以实现零样本协调
translated_abstract: 在物理世界中工作的机器人将越来越需要与其他机器人协调，特别是在操作任务中，物体可能太大或太重，单个机器人无法独自搬运。由硬件退化或执行器故障导致的物理限制会制约机器人能够可靠执行的动作，而这些限制对其伙伴来说可能是未知的。我们研究一个辅助机器人能否通过观察目标机器人与另一个机器人协调的过程，来推断其物理约束，然后利用推断出的能力与同一伙伴在新任务上进行协调。这一任务之所以困难，是因为观察到的演示只显示了受限机器人做了什么，而未显示它本可以做什么。在物理耦合的任务中，另一个机器人还可能会补偿其局限性，使得仅从受限机器人的行为中难以识别这些限制。我们的关键洞察是，这些约束会塑造双方的联合行为……
tldr: 提出通过观察机器人伙伴与第三方机器人协同工作时的联合行为，来推断其未知的物理约束（如硬件退化或执行器故障），从而实现与该伙伴在新任务上的零样本协调。
en_tdlr: Proposes inferring a robot partner's unknown physical constraints (e.g., hardware degradation or actuator faults) from the joint behavior observed while it coordinates with a third robot, enabling zero-shot coordination with that partner on new tasks.
